---
title: "Summary of the Anonymization Workflow"

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Learning Objective

- After completing this part of the tutorial, you will understand the anonymization workflow.
:::

This chapter summarizes the full anonymization workflow. Use it as a reference or checklist when you work through your own data.

```{=html}
<style>
.wf { max-width: 820px; margin: 1.4rem auto 0.6rem; }
.wf-step {
  position: relative;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.85rem;
  background: #EAF4EE;
  border: 1.5px solid #00883A;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0.6rem 1rem 0.6rem 0.6rem;
  transition: box-shadow .15s ease, transform .15s ease;
}
.wf-step:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,136,58,.28); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.wf-step.wf-static:hover { box-shadow: none; transform: none; }
.wf-num {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 2.1rem; height: 2.1rem;
  background: #00883A; color: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem;
}
.wf-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.wf-title {
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.02rem; color: #006426;
  text-decoration: none;
}
a.wf-title:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
/* stretched link: whole card is clickable (only for real links) */
a.wf-title::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0;
}
.wf-desc { font-size: 0.9rem; color: #333; margin-top: .15rem; line-height: 1.35; }
/* links inside the description sit above the stretched overlay */
.wf-desc a { position: relative; z-index: 1;
  color: #00883A; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted #00883A; padding: 0 1px;
}
.wf-desc a:hover { background: #00883A; color: #fff; border-radius: 3px; }
.wf-arrow { text-align: center; color: #00883A; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1; margin: .18rem 0; }
.wf-loop { color: #00883A; font-weight: 600; }
</style>

<div class="wf">

  <div class="wf-step" id="wf-1">
    <span class="wf-num">1</span>
    <div class="wf-body">
      <a class="wf-title" href="../foundations/mechanisms.html">Implement Data Privacy</a>
      <span class="wf-desc">Privacy by design before &amp; during collection: minimize data, plan storage/access, write a DMP.</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wf-arrow">&#9660;</div>

  <div class="wf-step" id="wf-2">
    <span class="wf-num">2</span>
    <div class="wf-body">
      <a class="wf-title" href="../foundations/personal-data.html">Collect Data &amp; Handle Identifiers</a>
      <span class="wf-desc">Use informed consent and pseudonymize early. Remove direct identifiers from every copy, store the pseudonym key separately, and work from a secure identifier-free copy.</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wf-arrow">&#9660;</div>

  <div class="wf-step wf-static" id="wf-3">
    <span class="wf-num">3</span>
    <div class="wf-body">
      <span class="wf-title">Run Analysis</span>
      <span class="wf-desc">Do your analysis, writing, and collaborator sharing on the identifier-free working copy.</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wf-arrow">&#9660;</div>

  <div class="wf-step" id="wf-4">
    <span class="wf-num">4</span>
    <div class="wf-body">
      <a class="wf-title" href="../foundations/privacy-concepts.html">Analyze Attack Scenarios</a>
      <span class="wf-desc">Consider adversaries and disclosure risks (identity, attribute, inference, membership); set a k-anonymity goal.</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wf-arrow">&#9660;</div>

  <div class="wf-step" id="wf-5">
    <span class="wf-num">5</span>
    <div class="wf-body">
      <a class="wf-title" href="../anonymisation-techniques/planning-privacy.html">Calculate Disclosure Risk &amp; Utility</a>
      <span class="wf-desc">Measure k-anonymity and risk metrics; establish a utility baseline (e.g.&nbsp;sdcMicro).</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wf-arrow">&#9660;</div>

  <div class="wf-step" id="wf-6">
    <span class="wf-num">6</span>
    <div class="wf-body">
      <a class="wf-title" href="../anonymisation-techniques/overview-methods.html">Choose Anonymization Measures</a>
      <span class="wf-desc">Select a technique:
        <a href="../anonymisation-techniques/non-perturbative.html">non-perturbative</a>,
        <a href="../anonymisation-techniques/perturbative.html">perturbative</a>,
        <a href="../anonymisation-techniques/deassociative.html">de-associative</a>, or
        <a href="../anonymisation-techniques/synthetic.html">synthetic</a>. In doubt, aim for k-anonymity: if attackers don't already know the sensitive attribute, it is usually protection enough.
      </span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wf-arrow">&#9660;</div>

  <div class="wf-step" id="wf-7">
    <span class="wf-num">7</span>
    <div class="wf-body">
      <a class="wf-title" href="../anonymisation-techniques/choosing-technique.html">Apply Anonymization Techniques</a>
      <span class="wf-desc">Apply chosen techniques step by step; track changes with sdcMicro.</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wf-arrow">&#9660;</div>

  <div class="wf-step" id="wf-8">
    <span class="wf-num">8</span>
    <div class="wf-body">
      <a class="wf-title" href="../privacy-openness/balancing.html">Recalculate Risk, Utility &amp; Statistics</a>
      <span class="wf-desc">Re-measure after each step. If the balance is not satisfactory,
        <a href="#wf-4" class="wf-loop">&#8635; return to Step 4</a> and iterate.</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wf-arrow">&#9660;</div>

  <div class="wf-step" id="wf-9">
    <span class="wf-num">9</span>
    <div class="wf-body">
      <a class="wf-title" href="../privacy-openness/documentation.html">Document the Process</a>
      <span class="wf-desc">Internal (auditing) and external (data dictionary) documentation; review scripts; inform that results may not be fully reproducible in README.</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wf-arrow">&#9660;</div>

  <div class="wf-step" id="wf-10">
    <span class="wf-num">10</span>
    <div class="wf-body">
      <a class="wf-title" href="../privacy-openness/balancing.html">Publish Data</a>
      <span class="wf-desc">Share anonymized data + documentation; pick repository &amp; access level (fully open is best).</span>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
```
